metadata.description: 5-inch FPV quadcopter reference model (in development: plant only). NED world / FRD body axes, quaternion 6-DOF rigid body, four first-order motor/propeller subsystems. Parameters from the kingfisher model in uzh-rpg/agile_flight (MIT) and Kaufmann et al. 2022; equation structure after uzh-rpg/flightmare (MIT). See docs/fpv-reference-model-plan.md.
